title: Rank 1 is enough for a rank-1 update
notes: Every row of D is (−1, 1, −1, 1) or its negative, so D has rank 1. A rank-1 adapter is a column B times a row A: 8 numbers for a 16-number update. B starts at 0, so the first step moves only B. The loss falls from 16 to 0.11 in 20 steps, and to 0.00 by step 60.
